name: sistema-gestion-clientes
description: Sistema de gestión de clientes, pagos e instalaciones

scripts.dev: node scripts/stop-servers.js --summary && npm run ensure-deps && concurrently -n "server,client,browser" -c "blue,green,yellow" "npm run server:watch" "npm run client" "npm run open-browser"
scripts.dev:force: concurrently -n "server,client,browser" -c "blue,green,yellow" "npm run server:watch" "npm run client" "npm run open-browser"
scripts.dev:no-browser: npm run ensure-deps && concurrently "npm run server:watch" "npm run client"
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.install-all: npm install --no-audit --no-fund && cd server && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && cd ../client && npm install --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.postinstall: echo Instalación completada. Si hay errores, ejecuta 'npm run install-all' manualmente.
scripts.start:ngrok: npm run build && set NODE_ENV=production && concurrently -n "server,ngrok" -c "blue,yellow" "npm run start" "npm run ngrok"
scripts.start:cloudflare: npm run build && set NODE_ENV=production && concurrently -n "server,cloudflare" -c "blue,cyan" "npm run start" "npm run cloudflare"
scripts.start:localtunnel: npm run build && set NODE_ENV=production && concurrently -n "server,localtunnel" -c "blue,green" "npm run start" "npm run localtunnel"
